options.title: Module B (option cushion), C (stock put selling), D (Bank Nifty straddle) - NAHI chale
options.note: Asli option data nahi mila, isliye skip kiye (model ke number pe bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta).
bullets: Fyers expired option contracts ka data nahi deta; live contracts sirf listing se (Nov 2026 waale kuch hafte).

NSE bhavcopy (disk pe) me NIFTY / BANKNIFTY options sirf DAILY, Oct 2021 se, aur sirf 3 sabse paas ki expiry: 30-45 DTE monthly 15-delta strikes, intraday 20/30% leg stop, stock puts - inme se kuch bhi asli data se test nahi hota.
Bank Nifty weekly contracts: bhavcopy me Oct 2021 - Nov 2024 tak hain; 20 Nov 2024 se weekly band (SEBI), ab sirf monthly.
Model mode (Black-Scholes + India VIX) me 15-delta strike ka premium, skew aur intraday stop-loss bilkul alag aate hain - result 'MODELLED, low confidence' bhi kehne layak nahi, isliye nahi chalaya.
Chahiye: NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / stock options ka expired-contract 1-min (ya kam se kam daily) data 2018 se - koi data vendor (jaise TrueData / GDFL) se.
